services.name: The Early Bird Cruise
services.desc: About Savor the calm of an early morning on the harbor with a personalized cruise experience. Start your day with fresh bagels, breakfast sandwiches, wraps, fresh fruit, coffee, and orange juice—or kick it up a notch with a morning mimosa. Cruise gently through the harbor or anchor at our private Onda Bella mooring off Asharoken Beach, where you can paddleboard or take a dip in the beautiful water! It’s your morning, your way—and our pleasure to make it

services.name: The Viaggio Cruise (afternoon cruises)
services.desc: About Personalize your cruise with an array of fine wines from Del Vino Vineyards in Northport, craft beer from the local Sand City Brewery, and our exquisite "Bella Boards" artisanal charcuterie, along with New England Style Lobster Rolls. Your experience is yours to design: either glide serenely through the harbor or anchor at the exclusive Onda Bella mooring off Asharoken Beach. services.name: The Sunset Sereno Cruise
services.desc: About Step aboard our electric vessel and set sail through the picturesque Northport Harbor, where the only sound you'll hear is the gentle splash of water behind the boat as the sun sets along the horizon. Elevate your cruise with fine wines from Del Vino Vineyards, craft beer from Sand City Brewery, our signature "Bella Boards" artisanal charcuterie, and New England-style lobster rolls. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply seeking a peaceful escape, our Sunset Sereno cruise promises an unforgettable

blurb: Guests enjoy a two-hour private cruise on a quiet electric boat in Northport Harbor. Cruises include options for swimming, paddleboarding, and customizable add-ons like food and drinks. The boat accommodates up to 6 guests with a dedicated captain.
